name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: Storage cleanup is a finished workspace: TV grouped into show/season folders, cover art on movies/shows/episodes, native checkboxes (including season/show with partial state), a size calculator for eligible/selected/reclaimed bytes, and delete-only removal after two confirmations. Downloads has selection vs activity, bulk source consent, and download-to-this-server is live again. Plex share codes from 0.0.127 still auto-connect without a shared Tailscale; Companion also keeps revocable per-friend Plex relays and stable Jellyfin-to-Plex .strm playback, and can auto-create Plex Movies/Shows libraries for imports.
